# Apex Works

> Apex Works is based in Monroe, Washington. We do website audits for Washington businesses, monthly hosting and upkeep, and AI optimization so tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend a business.

## Services

- [Apex Site Snapshot](https://theapexworks.com/snapshot): A $499 one-time website audit. Plain-English score, a prioritized fix list, an AI-recommendation check, a 20-minute Zoom walkthrough, and the report within about 48 hours. We promise the process and the reporting, not rankings.
- [Site Care Plan](https://theapexworks.com/site-care): Monthly hosting, upkeep, AI optimization, and a monthly report that includes AI prompt testing. No price is listed on the page. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing.
- [AI optimization](https://theapexworks.com/ai-optimization): Help getting a Washington business named when people ask ChatGPT and Google's AI answers for a recommendation. No price is listed on the page. Email damon@theapexworks.com for pricing. This does not guarantee a recommendation.
